mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_feature_version(feature_version_id, feature_code, feature_name, business_category, version_no, result_value_type, handler_code, implementation_version, implementation_hash, timeout_ms, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES(#{row.featureVersionId}, #{row.featureCode}, #{row.featureName}, #{row.businessCategory}, #{row.versionNo}, #{row.resultValueType}, #{row.handlerCode}, #{row.implementationVersion}, #{row.implementationHash}, #{row.timeoutMillis}, #{row.status}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT feature_version_id, feature_code, feature_name, business_category, version_no, result_value_type, handler_code, implementation_version, implementation_hash, timeout_ms, status, create_time, update_time FROM t_feature_version WHERE feature_version_id IN #{id}
